title: ChatGPT Can Transcribe Voice Notes — But Check This First! #shorts
description:
ChatGPT added audio-file uploads on October 6, 2026, for supported paid subscriptions. You can ask for a transcript, summary, and action items, but transcription may make mistakes—especially with names, numbers and speakers. The visuals here are original illustrative reconstructions, NOT footage from a live ChatGPT session. Always verify important details against the original recording.

Official announcement: https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-release-notes
Audio-upload guide: https://help.openai.com/en/articles/8555545-uploading-files-and-audio-to-chatgpt
